programme.desc: An HBO Original Film of a young man who contracted AIDS and returns home to prepare for death with his estranged family.

programme.title: FERRELL TAKES THE FIELD

programme.desc: HAMNET tells the powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.

programme.desc: For millennia, plagues, curses, and the violent destruction of cities have been blamed on the wrath of gods. But were these divine punishments mere myth, or is there proof they are based on real events?

programme.title: Pawn Stars (S24)
programme.desc: Spencer drops into the shop with some tasty new finds, but will Rick bite? Then, Chum and Rick disappear from the shop to meet up with a magician selling a zigzag box.

programme.title: American Godfathers: The Five Families
programme.desc: Follows the American Mafia from their early development in New York City through Prohibition to the boom days of the 1950s. It explores the families' operations and their alleged code of honour.

programme.title: The Food That Built The World (S4)
programme.desc: When an entrepreneur creates the first of its kind shelf-stable peanut butter, it leads to the birth of an iconic sandwich. And as competition heats up to be America's favorite, three brands battle it out.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd (S3)
programme.desc: From a man blasted by a high-pressure air hose to a lumberjack who survived near decapitation, these are mishaps that are so wild, they border on the impossible.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny (S2)
programme.desc: History's boldest missions succeeded because the world looked away. The CIA hid covert missions behind Air America's façade; British intelligence planted a fake invasion plan on a corpse to mislead Hitler.

programme.title: Alone (S11)
programme.desc: With new weather patterns looming, the days are numbered for those counting on foraging to pull them through. One survivalist is left confused as the Arctic takes back its gift.

programme.title: History's Greatest Warriors
programme.desc: The Mongol's skill in horseback archery and mobility build him into the most elite fighter of his time. Emerging in the 13th century under Genghis Khan, the Mongol utilises advanced tactics and discipline.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: The Pacific campaign reaches a brutal and bloody fever pitch from 1944 to 1945.

programme.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
programme.desc: The war in Europe reaches a climax as Allied armies advance towards Berlin, and Hitler orders his people to fight to the last man.

programme.title: The Death Coast
programme.desc: Jeff and his team's search for the wrecks of Mary, Joseph, and Neptune takes them further into uncharted territory. Jeff begins to suspect he may be on the verge of uncovering a field of stolen treasure.
